graham.brief:
The interesting part of this game is a unit, not a player. The Jets are the 4th-most run-first offense in football, running more than the situation calls for. That's the part worth watching.

Detroit gets clean runs before contact, and the Jets keep playing light in the box. Consensus is the least interesting thing on a slate, so I went looking underneath it.

According to New York Jets, receiver Adonai Mitchell (Finger) & Edge Joseph Ossai (Foot) Questionable. Jared Goff is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps, and the Jets carry the 5th-heaviest injury load in the league.

The price and the profile are pointed the same way here. Detroit is favored by 7 with a 48.5 total, and the books look for about 28 points from them. The profiles and the price landed on the same lopsided game. If the first quarter is loud in the Jets, I read this one wrong.
